The witness report does not mention any game discs or digital licenses.

risks.proof: A photo of the 'System Storage' menu in the console settings.
A clear close-up photo of the sticker on the back of the controllers showing the FCC ID and serial number.
A video showing a disc being inserted, recognized, and launched.
risks.if_unproven: as having a broken disc drive.

risks.proof: A video showing the console successfully logging into the PlayStation Network.
A photo showing all 10 game cases or the digital library on the console.

proof_requests: Photo of the 'System Information' screen showing software version and storage.
Photo of the 10 games mentioned by the seller.
Close-up photo of the back labels of the red controllers.

response.reason: The witness has confirmed the item is a PS4 Pro. It can be priced at its worst-case functional and storage state until further proof is provided.
